method: Whole I/D images and native crops of frame edges, horizon, objects and maximum residuals, with unthresholded difference maps and all-meshlet controls. Inspection list was written before looking at the images in tmp/cooked-draw/inspection-plan.md.
residual_class: draw-partition-dependent shading residuals, without a low-level derivative/ordering attribution
negative_controls: Each D-only omission visibly removes the terrain placement. R-after retains its output and independently derived command arguments. Restored D is exactly R.
inspection_plan:
M1.3 inspection of replanned-paths, before viewing its images.
For each of noon 0/18/36, low Sun and diagnostic, compare I/D whole frames, terrain edges/silhouettes, texture/material detail, shadow direction/shape, and native crops around the maximum residual plus frame edges/horizon/objects. Diagnose residuals with I/all/R controls. Require complete same geometry and outward-facing plain/mirrored twins, full diagnostic volume and no visible seams, holes or objectionable shading. Cross-partition counts/deltas are observations only. Exact D/R and repeat/control failures are independent gates.
M1.10 rotation inspection requires image fill and correct aspect at each new current extent. Compare native simulator landscape/portrait and existing presenter viewport formula against the actual recorded extents.
final_source_refresh: The integrated M7 renderer and final probe reproduce all fifteen retained inspected I/D/omit images byte-exact after decoding, plus all retained difference maps/native crops. All five revised oracle/control cases pass again.
